conflicts.resolution: Hold company-level canonical merge. Current company search excerpt is discovery only; retain dated primary Red Sea Farms and iyris observations separately.
Do not select a single legacy founding year. Current legal incorporation is independently company-reported as 2024-02-21.
Keep predecessor seed funding outside current 2024 company funding projection.
2022 source describes a three-person founding team. Two named cofounders are verified in 2025; a third name is not invented.
Substantive body and domain identify Impact46; do not create an Impact64 entity from HTML title.

notes: Source registry counts unique URLs attempted, not all HTTP requests, redirect hops or repeated find/open operations.
Additional leads were only noticed in already read pages; they are not accepted startups.
The 60-attempt planning bound was interpreted as unique source URL attempts; search queries and repeated line-window reads are counted separately.
No portfolio or cohort has been exhaustively paginated. No nationwide denominator exists in this packet.
